title: How do I apply an employer payment to Corporate Wellness Partnership dues?
content:
A payment may only be applied once at least one billing-cycle charge has been recorded against the enrollment, since there is nothing yet owed to apply it against. Once that holds, applying a payment received from the employer's master account toward a Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment decreases the net amount currently owed by the employer's master account and adds a payment entry to the enrollment's billing history.

This action is performed by the customer's own tool, which must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: record_corp_dues_payment_5148c010.

Parameters:
- enrollment_id — the reference number of the enrollment the payment is being applied to, read from the enrollment record.
- amount_usd — the dollar amount actually applied against the balance, in USD, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Return: a confirmation of the new payment-history entry's reference number, the amount applied, and the enrollment's resulting balance owed by the employer's master account. No error condition other than the enrollment not being found applies to this action.
